lines.text: The sound of the alarm signifies the arrival of morning.
and see the familiar ceiling of the Commander's Room that I'm used to seeing every morning.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I was about to wake you up...
I turn to find D sitting on my bed in her disguise.
D, what are you doing in my bed?!
As D leans forward, I pick up the faint smell of violet.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: You remembered, so don't forget to keep calling me that.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I thought we'd decided to call each other by our nicknames?
O-oh, right. Now I remember, Honey.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Good, you'd do well to remember that.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Hehe, hurry and get up now.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll go and prepare breakfast before the others come.
You're going to make me breakfast?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: and I love nothing more than to prepare breakfast for my honeybun.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: you have guests this early in the day?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: What kind of tea should I prepare for our guests, Honey?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I-is there something wrong with my ears?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: D-did she just say "Honey"? Like, "Oh, my darling" and all that jazz?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Am I reading this wrong, or...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Master! When did you get married in secret?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How can we calm down at a time like this?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You didn't really get married, did you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Does this mean you're going to leave us?
What are you talking about? It's not what you think...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: it's our first day as newlyweds,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: and you're already giving someone else more attention than me?
The edge of D's axe glistens ominously from behind her back.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What the... are you threatening him?!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Master, blink twice if you're in danger!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We got married because we love each other.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: If you know who I am, you would do well to stop now, turn around, and return to where you came from.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'm doing everything for my husband.
I'm in the middle of something. We'll talk about this later.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You can't seriously be letting this happen?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What about me? Can I stay a little longer?
Rapi drags Anis and Neon outside.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Hold on, aren't you forgetting something?
This isn't what I signed up for.
I said I was married to a kind-hearted woman.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: no matter how kind a woman may be,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: in a situation where it seems like her husband might be taken away...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It isn't set in stone that I have to be all sugar and spice.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Now that we're on the same page, why don't you get cleaned up?
Even after breakfast, our role-play as newlyweds continues.
D locks her arm with mine.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Er... I think I've been watching too much TV lately.
As she leaves, Signal murmurs to herself about having to quit watching TV.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Huh?! I must have forgotten to take my supplements!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Did she just say what I think she said?
Folkwang leaves to find her supplements.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: No, I don't want to hear it anymore!

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: If I hear one more word, I think I'm gonna be sick.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I'm going shopping to take my mind off all this nasty business.
Rupee storms off in a huff.
D is sitting elegantly, while preparing a fruit Splendamin.
I don't think this is helping me in any way.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Do you think you're working hard enough to improve your skills?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Then what do you think will help?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: A different environment? A different attitude?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Will that potentially help immerse you in a role that you're acting?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Are you sure you're not trying to make things not get too complicated

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: and weasel your way out of your obligation, are you?
That's most certainly not the case.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: In light of all this attitude you're giving me,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: do you think I really believe that?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: For the past two days, all you've done is act embarrassed and uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: a change of venue will help?
I'm sorry. I know I've made it hard for you to trust me,
but can you trust me one final time?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: And why would I do that?
I don't think I'll be able to immerse myself in the role here.
I just don't want to waste your precious off time.
So let's move and start over.
I will be your stalwart husband and a Commander working at the Outpost.
And you'll be my kind-hearted and adorable wife.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: but we'll keep the other details the same.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: You can treat this place as your office,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: If we do that, will you be able to fully commit yourself to this?
D stabs her paring knife into the table.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: If you ever stare at another Nikke during our time together,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: or if you complain that you can't focus,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll find a way to eliminate whatever is interfering with your focus.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: All right, wait here for a moment.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll look into securing a new place.
